info.name: FleetOS DriverX API
info.description: FleetOS DriverX driver app REST API. Base URL {{baseUrl}}. Auth is phone-OTP with a Bearer {{accessToken}} on all endpoints except auth/onboarding ones; run "Auth ▸ Verify OTP" first to auto-populate {{accessToken}} (and {{refreshToken}}). Money is in minor units (e.g. total_minor 3800 = 38.00 QAR) with a sibling currency_code.

request.description: Same endpoint as Request OTP; the SignIn/OTP screen 'Resend code' button re-invokes it. Backend rate-limits per phone.

GAP/DECISION: SignInScreen exposes a password field and drivers.password exists, but the wired flow is OTP-only. If password auth is kept, this endpoint mirrors Verify OTP's token response. Confirm whether the driver app keeps password login or is OTP-only.

GAP/DECISION: ForgotPasswordScreen sends a reset code via /auth/otp/request (purpose=reset) then goes to OTP. If password auth is kept, this sets the new password after the code is verified. Omit if the app is OTP-only.
GAP: AccountActionsScreen 'Delete account' is a snackbar today ('requires office confirmation'). Creates an office-confirmed deletion request; the account stays active until the office approves.
Writes driver_presence.status/busy_reason. status 'on_trip' is server-set on assignment — do not send it. Mirrored on socket driver:availability.
Location heartbeat -> driver_presence.lat/lng/heartbeat_at. Also socket driver:presence.
GAP (optional): the map 'Airport queue · low wait' ZonePill is hardcoded. Returns nearby demand/queue hints for the cockpit. May instead be pushed via a socket zone:demand event.
Accept the dispatch_offer for this ride_booking. Sets ride_bookings.status='assigned', driver_id, assigned_at; driver_presence.status='on_trip'.
Rider onboard; ride_bookings.status='in_progress'. Server emits meter:tick if pricing_style='meter'.
Stops the meter, finalises fare_minor/total_minor; status stays in_progress until payment collected.
Settles the trip. Sets status='completed', completed_at; writes commission_earnings + wallet_transaction; presence back to 'online'.
Allowed for status in (scheduled, assigned, arrived). Sets status='cancelled'/'no_show', cancelled_at, cancel_reason.

GAP: the active-trip 'Rider' call button (home_screen _callRider) needs a number. Returns an office-masked / proxy number so the driver never sees the rider's real phone. The app then launches tel: via CallService.
Driver<->rider messages for a booking (booking_chat_messages). Loaded when the chat sheet opens + on reconnect. Realtime delivery is the socket chat:message event.
REST fallback for chat:send (idempotent via client_msg_id / X-Idempotency-Key). from_type is inferred from the authenticated principal ('driver').
Marks rider messages up to up_to_id as read (sets read_at). Mirrors socket chat:read.
ride_bookings with source='scheduled' offered to this driver. filter maps to service_class / zone.
Commits the scheduled booking to this driver. status stays 'scheduled' (surfaced on map) until /navigate.
Aggregated from commission_earnings + ride_bookings for the range. Money in minor units + currency_code.
GAP: the Home availability dock shows Today earnings / Trips / Online time / Wallet KPIs (hardcoded today). A lightweight summary so the dock doesn't load the full /earnings dashboard.
GAP: SavedPlaceEditScreen edits an existing place ('Save place'). Present in API_CONTRACT.md but missing from the JSON collection.
GAP: SavedPlaceEditScreen 'Search or drop a pin' address field. Geocode/autocomplete; may be backed by a geocoder provider rather than the DB.
GAP: HelpArticleScreen renders a single article body; the list endpoint returns summaries only.
GAP: the issue thread shows replies (GET) but the driver also needs to add one. Writes a driver reply to the `replies` table.
GAP: ShareStatusScreen 'Stop sharing' — revokes a status link created by POST /safety/status-links.
